pin.title: TaDaoSi Western Restaurant — Central Street — Harbin restaurant guide
pin.description: Russian and Western cooking at the Central Street branch. Published dishes include Ukrainian borscht, pot-braised beef and salmon. Menus and closure notices for other Central Street restaurants are not attributed to TaDaoSi.
pin.address: 127 Central Street, near West Fifth Street, Daoli, Harbin
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: Brand dates from 1901 (Ctrip: 创于1901年); first-pass blog says the Tatoc name was revived at this building in 2005 after it was the Jinjiao Hotel from 1947. Estimated: 2005 is a best estimate and 2005-12-31 is used only as a period-end sorting date, not a confirmed opening day.
